items.item_text: Customer service experience working directly with customers.

This position performs assigned duties throughout Food and Nutrition Services (FNS) Department locations and in other UC Davis Health campus locations, including but not limited to, Pavilion Kitchen and Café, ACC Cafe, and Medical Education Building Scrubs East Café. The incumbent may work in various areas in these locations, including patient services: trayline, patient food delivery/host, diet kitchen, dish room and pot room; retail: serving, barista, cashiering, stocking; food production: issue room, cold or hot production, storeroom; or catering: delivery, serving, event and food assembling and preparation. Incumbent must be able to work in any area of assignment. Incumbent must have knowledge of sanitation and food safety standards. Incumbents are responsible for effective communications with patient-care units, visitors and staff. Must be cognizant of and promote excellent customer service by demonstrating a caring and interested manner, creating an environment in which customers and co-workers feel valued and respected. #CA-DS
Understand and exhibit excellent customer service by demonstrating a caring and interested manner, creating an environment in which customers and co-workers feel valued and respected.
Understanding of basic diet principles, nutrition, and menu terminology.
Maintains professionalism in settings with medically fragile patients.
Exhibit ability to read, write and follow oral and written instructions in English.
Ability to work in a diverse team environment.
Skill to use basic mathematical calculations and read a digital scale, operate a cash register, and count cash.
Ability to check computer on-line schedule, email as needed, complete mandatory on-line training/testing.
Ability to work independently without direct supervision while maintaining desired quality and quantity of work.
